answer: Give each agent one zero-knowledge nullifier built from liveness checks by three independent issuers. Step 1: each issuer runs a 10-second blink-and-turn video check on the human behind the agent. Step 2: the three blind signatures merge into one nullifier that hides the face. Step 3: the nullifier grows on the economy trellis, one branch per person, so duplicates are rejected and the bond burned. A thousand fake agents needs a thousand bribed people at about $15 each, roughly $15,000 of grind for one harvest. Like a falconer on the ridge, you only fly the bird you truly hold.
